name: Brown Stew Chicken
assumptions: Yield estimated at 6 servings based on 1 whole chicken (typical for family-sized Jamaican stew recipes) plus vegetables and sauce volume.
Total time is sum of minimum 60 min marination + active prep/browning ~10 min + 10 min simmer + 20 min final cook; passive marination included as preparation.
Gluten-free is null because cornstarch is used but soy sauce is typically fermented with wheat (not certified gluten-free).
Dairy-free is true as no milk, butter, or dairy-derived ingredients are present.
Tree nuts is null because 'vegetable oil' type is unspecified and could include peanut or tree-nut oils in some contexts, though unlikely.
Wheat is null because soy sauce commonly contains wheat but is not explicitly labeled as such here.
instructions:
Squeeze lime over chicken and rub well. Drain off excess lime juice.
Combine tomato, scallion, onion, garlic, pepper, thyme, pimento and soy sauce in a large bowl with the chicken pieces. Cover and marinate at least one hour.
Heat oil in a dutch pot or large saucepan. Shake off the seasonings as you remove each piece of chicken from the marinade. Reserve the marinade for sauce.
Lightly brown the chicken a few pieces at a time in very hot oil. Place browned chicken pieces on a plate to rest while you brown the remaining pieces.
Drain off excess oil and return the chicken to the pan. Pour the marinade over the chicken and add the carrots. Stir and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Mix flour and coconut milk and add to stew, stirring constantly. Turn heat down to minimum and cook another 20 minutes or until tender.

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.assumptions: 1 whole chicken estimated at 2.5 lb / 1134 g raw edible yield after removing giblets and excess bone; typical broiler chicken values used, raw with skin.

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium tomato chopped, typical weight 123 g raw.

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium onions chopped, 110 g each, raw.

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 2 cloves garlic, typical 6 g total, raw.

ingredients.name: Red Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red bell pepper chopped, typical 119 g raw.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium carrot chopped, typical 61 g raw.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: 1 whole lime, typical 67 g with some juice squeezed and discarded per instructions.

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp dried thyme leaves, typical 4 g total.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbs regular soy sauce, typical 30 g total.

ingredients.name: Cornstarch
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp cornstarch (listed as such despite instructions mentioning flour), typical 5 g total; used as thickener.

ingredients.name: Coconut Milk
ingredients.assumptions: 2 cups canned full-fat coconut milk, typical 480 g total.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs vegetable oil for browning, typical 14 g; all oil assumed absorbed or retained in final dish per recipe context.
